risks.summary: Gateway Manual conflict. protocols.ts cites Gateway Manual v2.2 with paragraph refs for every protocol code; the capability notes on claude/sleepy-gauss-lezg26 assert no verified protocol documentation exists. The manual is not in this repository. Both cannot be true.
risks.impact: The entire Inter-Sprint protocol registry may be inferred rather than documented. Until settled, no Gateway behaviour may be inferred from it.
risks.resolution: One question to the owner or one email to the supplier. See docs/architecture/02_SUPPLIER_RULES.md.

risks.summary: document-analysis-jobs.ts queries document_analyses and document_extracted_lines. Neither table exists in production. Reached by /api/admin/ddt-import/status and /api/cron/document-analysis.
risks.impact: Either the feature is unused, or it is broken in production and unreported.
risks.resolution: Confirm usage before the reconciliation window; it decides whether migrations 20260901/20260902 are urgent.

risks.summary: Three migration lineages disagree. No repo filename matches any production ledger version. quote_requests exists in production with data but is absent from its ledger; four repo migrations are unapplied.
risks.impact: supabase db push against production today would be unpredictable.
risks.resolution: docs/DATABASE_BASELINE.md section 4. Do not push anything until executed.

risks.summary: The entire 9,559-row production catalogue hangs off supplier 'asdas' (vat_number 'ads'), created as a test record. 16 suppliers include four spellings of ZUIN, two of FINTYRE, two of CARLINI, plus placeholders 'Name' and 'Furnizor Demo (test)'.
risks.impact: Any sourcing, pricing or accounting grouped by supplier produces wrong totals.
risks.resolution: OWNER_DECISION D1 and D2. Evidence in docs/DATABASE_BASELINE.md section 6.

risks.summary: Inter-Sprint gateway defaults to plain HTTP with HTTP Basic auth; the FTP drop point is plain FTP open to the whole internet.
risks.impact: Credentials would cross the internet unencrypted. Nothing has been transmitted yet - no credentials exist.
risks.resolution: docs/SECURITY_FINDINGS.md findings 1 and 2. Ask the supplier about HTTPS/FTPS/SFTP and obtain egress IPs.

risks.summary: The only commercial observations are from 2026-09-08 and carry no price or stock. There is no freshness control because nothing consumes observations yet.
risks.impact: Prospective: presenting a stale or absent observation as live availability means wrong stock and wrong prices.
risks.resolution: A freshness gate belongs in the same change as the first customer-facing price, not later.

risks.impact: Any weight-based PFU rule is indeterminate for them.
risks.resolution: Must resolve to TO_CONFIRM, never a guess. Policy is OWNER_DECISION D4.

risks.summary: The supplier lane and capability model exists only on claude/sleepy-gauss-lezg26 and in staging, not in main. Porting it needs a migration.
risks.impact: Adding a migration while the ledger is divergent would deepen R3.
risks.resolution: Port after reconciliation. Proposed schema in docs/DATABASE_BASELINE.md section 5. Do not delete that branch - it holds the only copy.
